brief:
Gaza's chess community is rebuilding after three years of war, Al Jazeera English reported. Players have resumed competing and organizing tournaments, reclaiming a recreational space amid the destruction and displacement that has marked the conflict.

The return to chess represents an effort by Palestinians to restore normalcy and community bonds fractured by the prolonged violence. The sport had been largely abandoned as residents focused on survival during the intensity of the fighting.
dek: Gaza's chess players are returning to the sport after three years of genocide.
title: Gaza's chess players return to sport after genocide
